fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s winter season and tourist economy in relation to Havana, the absence of local racing, and appeals for advertising support of local newspapers. Columns discuss civic and municipal matters including street lighting, transit service complaints, and criticism of bankruptcy/receivership practices. Reports and commentary reference a grand jury report on Dade County commissioners’ expenditures and fees, legal developments involving a criminal libel suit, and public health/food handling concerns. Additional items cover Florida egg grading legislation, police mutual aid fund, and assorted local entertainment, nightlife, and promotional notices for Greater Miami and related developments such as the Tamiami Trail.
